description: Whole-view projection of an SW_ARXML namespace onto CommonModel: structural elements, active elements, ports, connections, and their Ownership/Expose/ConnectionSource/ConnectionTarget/ConnectionOwner relationships. ConnectionOwner is derived from has_connector with its endpoints swapped, because ARXML models it composition -> connector while CommonModel anchors it at the Connection.
cypher:
UNWIND $sourceNamespaces AS ns
MATCH (ci:RIA_UNIV_ConceptInstance)
WHERE ci.namespace = ns AND ci.concept IN ['ar_package', 'application_swc', 'composition_swc', 'ecu_abstraction_swc', 'service_swc', 'cdd_swc', 'sensor_actuator_swc', 'nv_block_swc', 'parameter_swc', 'service_proxy_swc', 'p_port', 'r_port', 'pr_port', 'assembly_connector', 'delegation_connector']
RETURN 'representative' AS row_type,
  CAST(ci.node_id AS STRING) AS id,
  CASE ci.concept
    WHEN 'ar_package' THEN 'StructuralElement'
    WHEN 'application_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'composition_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'ecu_abstraction_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'service_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'cdd_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'sensor_actuator_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'nv_block_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'parameter_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'service_proxy_swc' THEN 'ActiveElement'
    WHEN 'p_port' THEN 'OutPort'
    WHEN 'r_port' THEN 'InPort'
    WHEN 'pr_port' THEN 'InOutPort'
    WHEN 'assembly_connector' THEN 'Connection'
    WHEN 'delegation_connector' THEN 'Connection'
  END AS concept,
  ci.concept AS source_concept,
  ci.attributes AS attributes,
  ns AS source_namespace,
  CAST(ci.node_id AS INT64) AS source_node_id,
  '' AS source_property_path,
  '' AS sources_json,
  '' AS relationship, '' AS source_id, '' AS target_id
UNION ALL
UNWIND $sourceNamespaces AS ns2
MATCH (ri:RIA_UNIV_RelationshipInstance)
WHERE ri.namespace = ns2 AND ri.relationship IN ['contains_package', 'contains_swc_type', 'has_p_port', 'has_r_port', 'has_pr_port', 'provider_port', 'inner_port', 'requester_port', 'outer_port']
RETURN 'relationship' AS row_type,
  '' AS id, '' AS concept, '' AS source_concept, '' AS attributes,
  '' AS source_namespace, CAST(0 AS INT64) AS source_node_id, '' AS source_property_path, '' AS sources_json,
  CASE ri.relationship
    WHEN 'contains_package' THEN 'Ownership'
    WHEN 'contains_swc_type' THEN 'Ownership'
    WHEN 'has_p_port' THEN 'Expose'
    WHEN 'has_r_port' THEN 'Expose'
    WHEN 'has_pr_port' THEN 'Expose'
    WHEN 'provider_port' THEN 'ConnectionSource'
    WHEN 'inner_port' THEN 'ConnectionSource'
    WHEN 'requester_port' THEN 'ConnectionTarget'
    WHEN 'outer_port' THEN 'ConnectionTarget'
  END AS relationship, CAST(ri.source_node_id AS STRING) AS source_id, CAST(ri.target_node_id AS STRING) AS target_id
UNION ALL
UNWIND $sourceNamespaces AS ns3
MATCH (rio:RIA_UNIV_RelationshipInstance)
WHERE rio.namespace = ns3 AND rio.relationship = 'has_connector'
RETURN 'relationship' AS row_type,
  '' AS id, '' AS concept, '' AS source_concept, '' AS attributes,
  '' AS source_namespace, CAST(0 AS INT64) AS source_node_id, '' AS source_property_path, '' AS sources_json,
  'ConnectionOwner' AS relationship, CAST(rio.target_node_id AS STRING) AS source_id, CAST(rio.source_node_id AS STRING) AS target_id
